next_tickets.body: Question: does the support-preserved two-pulse winner transfer from injected closure truth to blinded high-current real pile-up candidates? Build a small reviewer-adjudicated gallery from runs 63/65 with unchanged model thresholds and compare template-fit, gradient-boosted tree, and sequence-head decisions. Expected information gain: separates injected-template closure from real pile-up morphology before adoption.
next_tickets.title: S19e: real high-current adjudication of support-preserved pile-up winner

scientific_summary: With train-only support-preserving augmentation, held-out winner is gradient_boosted_trees at 6.263 ns [6.113, 6.403] versus constrained_template_fit 15.522 ns. Charge res68 for the winner is 0.0606. Held-out runs are untouched; the result tests training-support density rather than held-out augmentation.
